_meta.format: id-based chain (parseTestCatalog): depends_on + input_from + expect. session_api (kind: graphql) is the proven path; the browser flavors are the mandatory fallback but are FLAGGED (unconfirmed forms) so the chain drives session_api.
_meta.purpose: The CRUDS reference run-chain (plan Phase 5): create_client → create_property (Property → Client via clientId) → create_job (Job → Property via propertyId) → read_job and ASSERT the 2-hop link (job.client.id == created client id AND job.property.id == created property id, both surfaced flat by get_job). Plus CRUD-S update, and a self-cleaning delete_client (cascade removes the property + job). Every write is sampleData/token-tagged. Proves: kind:graphql CRUD, the reference resolution across create→create→create, and the round-trip link on read-back.
notes: run_token: every created record is tagged with {{run_token}} + sampleData:true so re-runs are isolated and swept.
expect vars reference a parent step's captured extract as {{<parent_id>.<extract_key>}} (no `.outcomes.`); input_from uses <parent_id>.outcomes.<extract_key>.

invalid_input (Rule S) is NOT a catalog entry (no normal outcome fires) — it is unit-proven (platform-api reject_path) + confirmed live (jobCreate with a bogus propertyId → userErrors → invalid_input).
Run live against a signed-in secure.getjobber.com tab (session cookie); the browser flavors need a separate hardening pass before they can drive this chain.
